description: A rectangular ottoman with a tufted cushion on top. The base is upholstered in a light-colored, textured fabric and supported by four dark wooden legs with a classic turned design. The cushion has a slightly lighter shade than the base and features deep button tufting, creating a plush and inviting appearance. The piping around the edges of both the base and the cushion adds a refined touch. The dark wood legs provide a contrast to the lighter upholstery, lending an air of traditional elegance.
